title: Sync setting persistence and clock sync
summary: Feedback centers on whether sync-related settings are retained after leaving the car, alongside one complaint about the clock falling out of sync.

positive.summary: Positive feedback describes a workaround or process for saving the Sync setting to the user profile so it persists after locking the car.

negative.summary: Negative feedback reports that the clock does not keep accurate time and regularly falls out of sync.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mentions sync being on by default and instructions to check whether settings are saved, but the excerpts do not clearly show satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The topic blends at least two related but distinct subjects: saved Sync/HVAC settings and clock time synchronization.
Most examples are undetermined, so the available evidence is limited for drawing a clear sentiment pattern beyond the explicit positive and negative excerpts.
The excerpts are stratified samples and do not indicate how common these experiences are beyond the provided reviews.
